What Is an Integrated Football Girdle?

An integrated football girdle is a pressure garment that incorporates strategically positioned pads into the fabric. In contrast to individual pad inserts or old-school football pants, an integrated girdle holds the protective padding securely in position, minimizing movement during motion and enhancing impact absorption. This technology provides streamlined protection without the added bulk of older equipment design.

In particular, a 7 pad integrated football girdle features integrated pads over:

  • Hips (left and right)
  • Thighs (left and right)
  • Tailbone
  • Knees
  • Coccyx or extended hip/tail padding (in certain models)

This arrangement provides complete lower-body protection that is up to modern safety standards while accommodating mobility and ventilation.

1. Maximum Protection with Minimal Bulk

Protection is first at Tag Sports Gear. Our girdles are designed with high-density EVA foam padding that absorbs and disperses impact forces. Our 7 pad integrated football girdle design covers every exposed area without adding unwanted bulk or hindering your stride.

2. High-Quality Moisture-Wicking Materials

Sweat control is essential to player performance and comfort. Our built-in football girdle is made with moisture-wicking compression material that moves sweat away from the body and evaporates rapidly. This keeps you dry and in the zone even in fierce competition.

Performance-enhancing fit:

How an Integrated Football Girdle Improves Your Game

1. Faster Suit-Up Times

Gone are the days of arranging loose pads in football pants. With the 7 pad integrated football girdle, everything is pre-installed. Simply pull on your girdle and pants, secure your jersey, and you’re ready to go.

2. Consistent Pad Placement

Traditional football pants with pockets can allow pads to shift during play. Integrated girdles keep pads exactly where they belong—protecting your hips, thighs, and tailbone on every down.

3. Enhanced Confidence

Knowing you’re fully protected boosts mental focus. Players wearing integrated girdles report feeling more secure making tackles, taking hits, and exploding off the line.

Sizing and Fit Guide

Getting the right fit is essential to performance. Tag Sports Gear comes in sizes from Youth Small to Adult XXL to fit every body type of athlete.

How to measure:

Waist circumference: Take your measurement around your natural waistline.

Hip circumference: Take your measurement around the widest section of your hips.

Thigh circumference: Take your measurement around the thickest area of your thigh.

If unsure, size up for a looser fit or down for compression support.

Taking Care of Your Integrated Football Girdle

Correct care lengthens the lifetime of your equipment. Refer to the following easy-to-follow guidelines:

Wash after each use in cold water and mild detergent.

Dry only by air, not by high heat that destroys the foam padding.

Do not iron or bleach.

Store in a cool, dry location to preserve fabric elasticity.
